title: Ordinary sheaf determinant dual evaluation
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and M a sheaf of O_X-modules that is finite locally free of constant rank d, for d a natural number [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. Let M^dual = Hom_{O_X}(M,O_X) be the internal sheaf dual [def-pur-sheaf-hom]. Using sheafified sectionwise exterior powers [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power] and the ordinary sheaf tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], there exists an isomorphism (wedge^d M^dual) tensor (wedge^d M) ≅ O_X in the ordinary category of sheaves of O_X-modules. No derived category or shift is involved.

source.place: Tag 0BRT (lemma-smooth-proper), final paragraph: determinant of the normal sheaf is invertible with inverse the conormal determinant

proof.text: Construct the rank-zero free sheaf Z and the split short exact complex Z -> M -> M as before. Apply the adopted determinant_shortExact with ranks 0,d,d and extract invertibility of exteriorPower M d. Transfer it along (exteriorSheafPowerIso M d).symm by IsInvertible.of_iso, giving invertibility of the unchanged legacy determinant exteriorSheaf M d. The remaining dual-comparison and evaluation proof is unchanged.
Use exteriorSheaf_dual_iso to identify exteriorSheaf(M^dual,d) with Hom(exteriorSheaf(M,d),O_X).

Tensor this identification with the identity of F=exteriorSheaf(M,d). Use the braiding to put F first. For the invertible F, apply Scheme.Modules.nonempty_tensorObj_dual_iso_unit from the already proved module Dual, yielding F tensor F^dual ≅ O_X. Compose the three isomorphisms. This is the evaluation assertion contained in the same-unit invertible-dual node.

lean.statement:
theorem determinant_dual_evaluation (X : Scheme.{u})
    (M : X.Modules) (d : ℕ) (hfree : M.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank d) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory X.sheaf
    let L : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) :=
      Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheaf
        (SheafOfModules.homObj (R := X.sheaf) M
          (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)) d
    let F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) :=
      Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheaf M d
    Nonempty (L ⊗ F ≅ 𝟙_ (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)))
